description: WS-06 workspace disk budget (libs/core/workspace-budget.ts). disk_cap_bytes bounds the total size of ledger-registered workspaces (active/shared/runtime/workspaces, .worktrees, active/shared/runtime/git-indexes); min_free_bytes is a free-disk floor on the target volume (0 disables it); orphan_ttl_hours is how long a released or owner-terminal workspace is kept before the janitor workspace sweep deletes it. Env overrides: KYBERION_WORKSPACE_DISK_CAP_BYTES, KYBERION_WORKSPACE_MIN_FREE_BYTES, KYBERION_WORKSPACE_ORPHAN_TTL_HOURS.
